title: report
description: A page of sections, each a heading over parts: Markdown text, tables, cards, notes, diagrams, scripts, or HTML for what they cannot say.

eyebrow.description: A short line above the title, such as the kind of page and its date

lead.description: A sentence or two under the title that sums the page up

items.description: One key naming the kind of the part

text.description: Markdown; raw HTML in it is left out

html.description: HTML that goes in as it is

diagram.description: A diagram: a spec as floe diagram render takes it (id, width, height, title, parts); floe diagram example shows one of each kind

script.description: Something that moves: js, a function (el, data) { … } the page calls with an empty element in its place and data, any value. It runs in the page's sandbox, where fetch, XHR, images from elsewhere and forms are blocked
